Cc: procurement@sigma-sys.com
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SI Immersion: Joint Delivery Certification and Lab Roster Prep

Hi Rachel —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Sigma is excited to move a small cohort of our consultants through a joint immersion so they can co-deliver a proof-of-concept for one of our mutual customers in Q4. High-level asks:

- 2-week immersion (training + shadowing + one supervised co-delivery)
- Target outcomes: certified trainer roster (4 people), validated lab runbook for our cloud customers, and a handoff sheet for ongoing co-delivery.
- Preferred dates: week of Nov 9 for training, week of Nov 16 for shadowing/co-delivery.

Can you share a suggested agenda, required infra checklist, and an estimate of Redwood trainer capacity and costs? I attached our current runbook for context. Procurement is on copy for any contract addenda.

Appreciate a quick turnaround so we can align internal leads.

—Elena
Partner Enablement Manager
Sigma Systems

Hi Elena —

Fantastic — happy to run this. Quick proposal below (high level) and I copied Ben (partner ops) and Soojin (field enablement) to scope trainers and logistics:

1) Outcome-based agenda (2 weeks)
  - Week 1: Foundations + hands-on labs (2 full days + 3 half days) — topics: Redwood runtime, model routing policies, caching/batching patterns, deploy/rollout playbook.
  - Week 2: Shadowing + supervised co-delivery (pairing with Redwood trainer on a customer delivery).
  - Deliverables: trainer-facing certification checklist, customer-facing runbook, and a short eval suite for quality regressions.

2) Required infra & prep
  - Standard lab VM + single-GPU inference node per trainee (we can host or provide provisioning scripts).
  - Dataset placeholder and sample prompts from Sigma (we'll sandbox).
  - Access: service account + short-lived tokens; we'll provide a prep doc.

3) Capacity & cost
  - We can run a cohort of up to 8 consultants per cycle. Pricing estimate: flat services fee + per-seat training add-on. Ben will follow up with numbers and availability.

Next steps: Ben — can you prepare a one-pager with slot availability and a day-by-day agenda draft? Soojin — can you confirm trainer leads and the trainer roster? Elena — once we align on dates we will share the shared drive folder and the DocuSign link for the MSA addendum.

Thanks — I put a preliminary agenda in the shared Drive link below.

Rachel Kim
Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Thanks Rachel — logging a few logistics and resource notes so we can lock the plan:

- Proposed cohort size: 6–8 (recommend 6 first run for tighter shadowing).
- Trainer assignments: 2 Redwood trainers + 1 solutions engineer per cohort day (we'll rotate).
- Environments: we can offer Managed Labs (Redwood-hosted) or provide a provisioning repo for Sigma to run on their cloud. Managed Labs pricing: daily lab rate x number of seats.
- Compliance: if the customer requires private deployment for the co-delivery, we'll add a Private deployment checklist and early security signoff.

I'll assemble: lab-environment-checklist.pdf and trainer-roster.csv and a one-pager with a proposed cost range. ETA EOD Friday.
